use_cases.title: Competitive Activity
use_cases.subtitle: Simulate how rivals respond to a market move
use_cases.description: Model how OEMs, materials suppliers, and end customers react to a competitor's launch, pricing change, or M&A in industrial AM.

use_cases.title: Test a Value Proposition
use_cases.subtitle: Pressure-test a product positioning with simulated buyers
use_cases.description: Run a candidate value proposition past simulated end-customer agents (aerospace, medical, automotive...) and see which buy, which push back, and on what objections.

inputs.label: Value proposition statement
inputs.placeholder: e.g. 'Cut titanium aerospace bracket cost 35% by switching from 5-axis machining to multi-laser LPBF with in-process monitoring'

use_cases.title: Industrial AM Market
use_cases.subtitle: Whole-market 3-year evolution
use_cases.description: Run a top-down simulation of the industrial AM market across metal, polymer, and service-bureau segments. Toggle macro variables (tariffs, capex cycle, AI design adoption) and watch share, revenue, and consolidation play out year by year.

use_cases.title: End-User Demand Shift
use_cases.subtitle: Simulate a buying-behavior shock in a vertical
use_cases.description: Pick a vertical (aerospace, medical, automotive...) and trigger a demand shift: regulatory change, supply-chain reshoring, raw-material spike. See how OEMs and materials suppliers reprice and reposition.
